judged_text: The rss.items.each loop has no per-item error isolation: an item lacking a `content` tag (e.g. RSS feeds with only <description>), lacking `id` when `link` is unusable, or whose link passes the /^https?\:\/\// regex but fails URI parsing in absolutize_urls raises and aborts the whole loop. One malformed feed item permanently halts import of every item after it: items before the failure are imported, the rest are silently skipped, and with retry: false nothing re-attempts until the next hourly run — the feed silently stops importing new posts while the job still 'ran'.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` without any per-item rescue. If `i.content` is `nil` (common when feeds only have `<description>`), `nil.scrub` will raise and abort the entire job mid-loop. Also, `TopicEmbed.import` calls `absolutize_urls(url, contents)` which does `URI(url)` and does not rescue `URI::InvalidURIError`; a malformed-but-regex-matching `url` would raise and similarly abort processing remaining items. With `sidekiq_options retry: false`, that failure will not be retried by Sidekiq and will prevent importing later items in that run.
